requirement: Test external file permission revocation and external edit conflicts before privileged writes.

dedicatedNativeVerification.profile: headful Chrome on Xvfb / real OS directory picker

observedNativeSequence: A real headful Chrome page invokes showDirectoryPicker({mode:'readwrite'}) with user activation and selects a real Linux directory through the native picker UI.
The returned FileSystemDirectoryHandle reports read=granted and readwrite=granted.
OpenContainer reads linked.txt and records the real selected-file SHA-256 revision.

An external process changes linked.txt from outside-v1 to outside-v2; the next privileged OpenContainer write fails OC_STALE_GENERATION with external-change-detected and silentOverwritePrevented=true.
After explicit revision refresh, the reconciled linked write succeeds only after permissionRechecked=true and is visible in the selected OS file.
The selected directory is removed through the native FileSystemDirectoryHandle.remove() path; the same handle transitions read/readwrite permission from granted to denied.
A subsequent privileged write fails OC_INVALID_STATE before publication with privilegedWriteBlocked=true while the independent local canonical recovery state remains unchanged.
